# Private parts

medrec's own fixture for what of an open item is private, from medrec-cli 0.9.9's `tests/fixtures/parts`: one invented person's records. `index.json` and `text.json` are byte for byte medrec-cli's.

`views/` is all that `medrec views write` wrote for the folder (`scripts/own-folder.mjs`, with the household of `../words`). `node scripts/derived.mjs`, with medrec on `PATH`, rebuilds it. Every value is invented.
